content.mcp.badArgs.text: "args" must be a list of strings.
content.mcp.badArgs.note: An error adding an MCP server from a file: its definition's "args" field (keep it as it is) isn't a list of text.

content.mcp.badCommand.text: "command" must be the program to run.
content.mcp.badCommand.note: An error adding an MCP server from a file: its definition's "command" field (keep it as it is) is empty or not text.

content.mcp.badCwd.note: An error adding an MCP server from a file: its definition's "cwd" field (keep it as it is) isn't text.

content.mcp.badName.text: Server names may contain letters, numbers, "-" and "_" (max 64 characters). "combwork" is reserved.
content.mcp.badName.note: An error adding an MCP server: its name has a character a server name can't have, is too long, or is combwork (Combwork's own server: keep it as it is).

content.mcp.badRecord.text: "{field}" must be an object of strings.
content.mcp.badRecord.note: An error adding an MCP server from a file: its definition's {field} field (env or headers, as it is) isn't a set of names with text values.

content.mcp.badUrl.text: "url" must be an http:// or https:// address.
content.mcp.badUrl.note: An error adding an MCP server from a file: its definition's "url" field (keep it as it is) isn't a web address.

content.mcp.changedAdd.text: {name} has changed since it was shown to you. Check what it runs and add it again.
content.mcp.changedAdd.note: An error adding an MCP server to a project or the Combwork Assistant: its definition ({name} is the server) changed after Combwork showed what it runs, so it is not added until checked again.

content.mcp.chooseFile.text: Choose a .json definition or a .zip of a server folder.
content.mcp.chooseFile.note: An error adding an MCP server from a file that is neither a .json definition nor a .zip.

content.mcp.exists.note: An error making a new MCP server: the workspace has one called {name}.

content.mcp.jsonLarge.text: The .json is too large for an MCP server definition (over {mb} MB).
content.mcp.jsonLarge.note: An error adding an MCP server from a .json file over {mb} MB.

content.mcp.listNoCommand.note: Why an MCP server in the workspace can't be used: its definition has neither of the two fields that say what it is. Keep "command", "url", stdio, http and sse as they are.

content.mcp.listNotObject.text: Definition must be a JSON object
content.mcp.listNotObject.note: Why an MCP server in the workspace can't be used: its definition file (.combwork/mcp/<name>.json) holds JSON that isn't an object.

content.mcp.noCommand.text: The definition needs a "command" (a server Combwork starts) or a "url" (an http or sse server).
content.mcp.noCommand.note: An error adding an MCP server from a file whose definition has neither field that says what it is. Keep "command", "url", http and sse as they are.

content.mcp.notJson.note: An error adding an MCP server from a file: its definition {file} can't be read as JSON. {reason} is the JSON reader's own words (English).

content.mcp.notObject.text: The definition must be a JSON object, as in {path}.
content.mcp.notObject.note: An error adding an MCP server from a file whose definition holds JSON that isn't an object. {path} is where a workspace keeps one (.combwork/mcp/<name>.json).

content.mcp.taken.text: A server named "{name}" already exists: choose another name, or replace it.
content.mcp.taken.note: An error adding an MCP server from a file under the name {name}, which a server of the workspace has.

content.mcp.zipFileLarge.text: The .zip is too large for an MCP server (over {mb} MB).
content.mcp.zipFileLarge.note: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip file over {mb} MB.

content.mcp.zipLarge.text: The .zip is too large for an MCP server (over {mb} MB unpacked).
content.mcp.zipLarge.note: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip: its files take more than {mb} MB unpacked.

content.mcp.zipLink.text: The .zip has a link, which Combwork doesn't unpack: {path}
content.mcp.zipLink.note: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip with a symbolic link in it ({path}), which could point outside its folder.

content.mcp.zipNoDefinition.text: No {files} found. A server .zip has its definition at its top level, or inside one folder.
content.mcp.zipNoDefinition.note: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip without a definition where Combwork looks. {files} are the file names it looks for, joined with "or".

content.mcp.zipTooMany.text: The .zip has too many files for an MCP server (over {max, number}).
content.mcp.zipTooMany.note: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip with more than {max} files.

content.mcp.zipUnreadable.text: The .zip can't be read: it has no list of its files.
content.mcp.zipUnreadable.note: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip that isn't one (no central directory: the list of its files).

content.mcp.zipUnsafe.text: The .zip has a file with an unsafe path: {path}
content.mcp.zipUnsafe.note: An error adding an MCP server from a .zip: a file's path ({path}) would land outside its folder, or Windows can't have it.

content.mode.badName.text: Give the mode a name with letters or numbers.
content.mode.badName.note: An error making a new mode for the Combwork Assistant: its name has no letters or numbers to name its file after.

content.mode.exists.text: There is already a mode called "{mode}".
content.mode.exists.note: An error making a new mode for the Combwork Assistant: the workspace already has one called {mode}.

content.mode.invalid.note: An error deleting a mode of the Combwork Assistant: its id isn't one Combwork could have made.

content.mode.noAssistant.text: The Assistant has no settings in this workspace.
content.mode.noAssistant.note: An error switching the Combwork Assistant's mode: the workspace's Assistant settings are missing.

content.mode.notBundled.note: An error restoring a mode Combwork ships: Combwork ships no mode called {mode}.

content.mode.unknown.text: There is no mode "{mode}" in this workspace.
content.mode.unknown.note: An error switching the Combwork Assistant's mode: the workspace has no mode (a file in .combwork/modes) called {mode}.

content.notes.badName.note: An error renaming a shared note: the new name is empty or has a character Windows can't have in a name (such as / or :).

content.notes.closed.text: The workspace was closed or switched: nothing was changed.
content.notes.closed.note: An error: the workspace closed, or another opened in its window, while a handover was being renamed; nothing changed.

content.notes.deleteRoot.text: Cannot delete the shared folder itself
content.notes.deleteRoot.note: An error: the shared notes folder itself (.combwork/shared) can't be deleted, only what is in it.

content.notes.exists.note: An error making or renaming a shared note or folder: one called {name} is already there.

content.notes.nameRequired.note: An error making a shared note or folder with no name.

content.notes.outside.text: Path is outside the shared notes folder
content.notes.outside.note: An error: a shared note's path leads out of the workspace's shared notes folder (.combwork/shared).

content.skill.audience.text: {kind, select, text {its audience is "{audience}", not agents, assistant or all} empty {its audience is empty, not agents, assistant or all} list {its audience is a list, not agents, assistant or all} other {its audience is a {type}, not agents, assistant or all}}
content.skill.audience.note: Why nobody gets a Combwork skill: its header's metadata.audience isn't agents, assistant or all (keep those three words, which the header must say). {kind} is what it is instead: text ({audience} is the text), empty, a list, or another YAML value ({type}: number, boolean or object, as YAML names them). It starts in lower case (it follows a colon).

content.skill.badName.text: Skill names may contain letters, numbers, "-" and "_" (max 64 characters).
content.skill.badName.note: An error adding a skill: its name has a character a skill's name can't have, or is too long.

content.skill.cantCopyName.text: "{name}" can't be a Combwork skill name: use letters, numbers, "-" and "_" (rename the folder first).
content.skill.cantCopyName.note: An error copying a skill into the workspace: its folder's name {name} can't be a Combwork skill's name.

content.skill.cantDelete.text: Only Combwork skills and a project's local skills can be deleted in Combwork.
content.skill.cantDelete.note: An error deleting a skill Combwork doesn't manage (a CLI's own, from the user's profile or a plugin).

content.skill.chooseFile.note: An error adding a skill from a file that is neither Markdown (.md) nor a .zip.

content.skill.copyExists.text: The workspace already has a skill named "{name}"
content.skill.copyExists.note: An error copying a skill into the workspace: it has one called {name} already.

content.skill.exists.text: A skill named "{name}" already exists in {folder}
content.skill.exists.note: An error adding a skill: the skills folder {folder} (relative to the workspace) already has one called {name}.

content.skill.isCopy.text: That's Combwork's own copy of a workspace skill; delete the skill in the workspace instead.
content.skill.isCopy.note: An error deleting a skill in a project's folder that is Combwork's copy of a workspace skill (Combwork puts it there for a coding agent).

content.skill.metadata.text: its metadata isn't a set of fields (`metadata:`, then `audience: …` indented under it)
content.skill.metadata.note: Why nobody gets a Combwork skill: the metadata field of its SKILL.md header isn't a set of fields. Keep what is between backticks (`metadata:`, `audience: …`) as it is, backticks included: they mark YAML. It starts in lower case (it follows a colon).

content.skill.noLocalFolder.note: An error adding a project's own skill for a coding agent CLI ({cli}: "Codex") that reads no skills from a project's folder.

content.skill.noTarget.text: No place to add the skill to.
content.skill.noTarget.note: An error adding a skill with no place chosen for it (the workspace, or a project for a coding agent).

content.skill.notBundled.text: "{name}" isn't one of Combwork's bundled skills.
content.skill.notBundled.note: An error restoring a skill Combwork ships: Combwork ships no skill called {name}.

content.skill.notClosed.text: its header isn't closed (no line with --- after it)
content.skill.notClosed.note: Why nobody gets a Combwork skill: its SKILL.md header (front matter) starts with a --- line but no --- line ends it. Keep ---. It starts in lower case (it follows a colon).

content.skill.notClosedWithin.text: its header isn't closed within its first {kb} KB
content.skill.notClosedWithin.note: Why nobody gets a Combwork skill: its SKILL.md header (front matter, between --- lines) doesn't end within its first {kb} KB. It follows "Nobody gets this skill until its header is fixed:", so it starts in lower case.

content.skill.notFields.text: its header isn't a list of fields (`name: …`, `description: …`)
content.skill.notFields.note: Why nobody gets a Combwork skill: its SKILL.md header is YAML but not a set of fields. Keep what is between backticks (`name: …`, `description: …`) as it is, backticks included: they mark YAML. It starts in lower case (it follows a colon).

content.skill.notListed.text: That folder isn't a skill Combwork lists.
content.skill.notListed.note: An error listing a skill's files for its page: the folder asked for isn't one of the skills Combwork shows (the workspace's skills or a project's).

content.skill.notSkill.note: An error copying a skill into the workspace: its folder has no SKILL.md (a file name: keep it).

content.skill.yaml.note: Why nobody gets a Combwork skill: its SKILL.md header can't be read as YAML. {reason} is the YAML reader's own words (English). It starts in lower case (it follows a colon).

content.skill.yamlAt.note: Why nobody gets a Combwork skill: its SKILL.md header can't be read as YAML. {line} is the line of the file, {reason} the YAML reader's own words (English). It starts in lower case (it follows a colon).

content.skill.zipNoSkill.text: No SKILL.md found. A skill .zip has SKILL.md at its top level, or inside one folder.
content.skill.zipNoSkill.note: An error adding a skill from a .zip that has no SKILL.md where Combwork looks. Keep SKILL.md as it is: it is a file name.

content.skill.zipTooLarge.text: The .zip is too large for a skill (over {mb} MB unpacked).
content.skill.zipTooLarge.note: An error adding a skill from a .zip: its files take more than {mb} MB unpacked.

content.skill.zipTooMany.text: The .zip has too many files for a skill (over {max}).
content.skill.zipTooMany.note: An error adding a skill from a .zip: it has more than {max} files.

content.skill.zipUnsafe.text: The .zip has a file with an unsafe path: {path}
content.skill.zipUnsafe.note: An error adding a skill from a .zip: a file's path ({path}) would land outside the skill's folder.

content.templates.agentGone.text: That agent is no longer in the template.
content.templates.agentGone.note: An error adding one agent from a template: the template no longer has it (edited meanwhile).

content.templates.agentsChangedChoose.text: The project's agents changed since you chose their connections: nothing was changed. Choose them again.
content.templates.agentsChangedChoose.note: An error choosing connections for a project's agents (HI-2109): an agent was added, removed or moved after the dialog showed them, so nothing changed.

content.templates.cantLoad.text: The template can't be loaded yet:
content.templates.cantLoad.note: An error loading a template, above the list of what stops it (each line a reason).

content.templates.cantUse.note: An error: the template {name} can't be used; {problem} says why (a sentence).

content.templates.changedSince.text: The project's agents changed since you looked: open the template again.
content.templates.changedSince.note: An error loading a template: the project's agents changed after the Load template dialog showed them.

content.templates.changedWhile.text: The project's agents changed while the template was loading: nothing was changed. Open the template again.
content.templates.changedWhile.note: An error loading a template: the project's agents changed while it loaded, so nothing changed.

content.templates.checkFailed.note: Why a template can't be loaded: git couldn't tell whether the worktree {folder} of the agent {agent} it would remove has uncommitted work; {error} is why (often git's own words).

content.templates.combworkOnly.text: Combwork's own templates can't be changed: duplicate one into the workspace or a project to change it.
content.templates.combworkOnly.note: An error: saving, renaming, editing, importing into or deleting one of Combwork's own templates (the Combwork scope, read-only). Duplicate is a button: as Combwork names it.

content.templates.connectionAmbiguous.text: Several connections are called "{ref}": name one by its id ({ids}).
content.templates.connectionAmbiguous.note: An error loading a template or choosing connections (HI-2109): the name given ({ref}) is several connections' names; {ids} lists their ids.

content.templates.connectionChoices.text: These connection choices don't fit its agents: {keys}. Open it again.
content.templates.connectionChoices.note: An error loading a template or choosing connections (HI-2109): choices sent for a role it doesn't know or an agent it doesn't have (another window's, or the template changed meanwhile). {keys} lists them as given ('role boss', 'agent 7'): keep role and agent in English.

content.templates.connectionUnknown.text: No connection "{ref}" can be used in this workspace now: choose another.
content.templates.connectionUnknown.note: An error loading a template or choosing connections (HI-2109): the connection chosen ({ref}, its name or id) was removed, or its account turned off here, since it was offered.

content.templates.editedMeanwhile.text: "{name}" changed since you started editing it (saved again meanwhile): nothing was saved. Close the editor to see it as it is now.
content.templates.editedMeanwhile.note: An error saving an edited template: it was saved again elsewhere after the editor opened it.

content.templates.enterName.text: Enter a name for the template.
content.templates.enterName.note: An error saving or renaming a template with no name.

content.templates.failed.note: An error loading a template: making its agents failed, so nothing changed; {error} is why (often git's own words).

content.templates.gone.text: That template is no longer there.
content.templates.gone.note: An error: the template was deleted or renamed meanwhile.

content.templates.importNotJson.text: It isn't a Combwork agent template (not JSON).
content.templates.importNotJson.note: An error importing a template: the file isn't JSON.

content.templates.importTooLarge.text: It isn't a Combwork agent template (over {kb} KB).
content.templates.importTooLarge.note: An error importing a template: the file is larger than {kb} KB, more than any template.

content.templates.loading.text: A template is already being loaded into this project.
content.templates.loading.note: An error loading a template while another load into the same project is under way.

content.templates.nameEach.text: Enter a name for each of its agents.
content.templates.nameEach.note: An error loading a template: a name given for one of its agents is empty.

content.templates.nameEachTooLong.text: A name is at most {max} characters for each of its agents.
content.templates.nameEachTooLong.note: An error loading a template: a name given for one of its agents is longer than {max} characters.

content.templates.nameTaken.text: There is already a template called "{name}" there.
content.templates.nameTaken.note: An error renaming or editing a template: another template where it is kept (the workspace or a project) is called {name}.

content.templates.nameTooLong.text: A template's name is at most {max} characters.
content.templates.nameTooLong.note: An error saving or renaming a template whose name is longer than {max} characters.

content.templates.namesChanged.text: The names given for its agents no longer match the template: open it again.
content.templates.namesChanged.note: An error loading a template: the names chosen for its agents in the Load template dialog no longer fit it (it was edited meanwhile).

content.templates.noAgents.text: This project has no agents to save.
content.templates.noAgents.note: An error saving a project's agents as a template: it has none.

content.templates.noFile.note: An error importing a template: the file chosen is gone.

content.templates.noKey.text: Combwork couldn't read {project}'s key, and this template's agent names are made from it. Try again, or check the key in Project Settings → General.
content.templates.noKey.note: An error loading a template, or adding one of its agents, whose names hold the project's key (HI-B1 in a project whose key is HI): the key of the project ({project}, its name) couldn't be read. Project Settings → Agents is where the key is changed: use its translation.

content.templates.noKeySave.text: Combwork couldn't read {project}'s key, so the names can't be saved with it. Try again, or save without Use the project key in names.
content.templates.noKeySave.note: An error saving a project's agents as a template with "Use the project key in names" ticked: the key of the project ({project}, its name) couldn't be read. "Use the project key in names" is the tick box's label: use its translation.

content.templates.noWorkspace.note: An error: the workspace's templates need a workspace open.

content.templates.nothing.note: An error loading a template, nothing changed: {problem} is why, a sentence of its own (how many agents a project can have).

content.templates.overMax.text: It has {count, number} agents, and this project’s workflow allows {max, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}: raise Maximum agents in Version Control → Workflow first, or load it with its workflow. Nothing was changed.
content.templates.overMax.note: An error loading a template (HI-2058): its agents ({count}) are more than the project's workflow option Maximum agents ({max}), and its workflow, which would raise it, isn't applied. Maximum agents, Version Control and Workflow are names in the window: as translated there.

content.templates.running.text: {agent} is running or starting: stop it first.
content.templates.running.note: Why a template can't be loaded: the agent {agent} it would replace is running.

content.templates.scope.text: Unknown scope "{scope}": hive, workspace or project.
content.templates.scope.note: An error: where a template is kept must be hive, workspace or project (keep those three words: they are the values to use).

content.templates.started.text: An agent started meanwhile: nothing was changed. Stop it first.
content.templates.started.note: An error loading a template: one of the project's agents started while it loaded, so nothing changed.

content.templates.taken.text: {names} {count, plural, one {is already an agent} other {are already agents}} in {projects}: agent names are unique across the workspace, so rename {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.
content.templates.taken.note: Why a template can't be loaded: agents of other projects ({projects}) have its agents' names {names} ({count} of them). {names} and {projects} are lists, in the language's way ("B1 and R1").

content.templates.takenNothing.text: {names} {count, plural, one {is already an agent} other {are already agents}} in {projects}: agent names are unique across the workspace, so rename {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}. Nothing was changed.
content.templates.takenNothing.note: An error loading a template: agents of other projects ({projects}) took its agents' names {names} ({count} of them) while it loaded, so nothing changed. {names} and {projects} are lists, in the language's way ("B1 and R1").

content.templates.twice.text: Two of its agents would be called "{name}".
content.templates.twice.note: An error loading a template: the names given for its agents call two of them {name}.

content.templates.uncommitted.text: {agent} has uncommitted work in its worktree ({folder}): commit or discard it first.
content.templates.uncommitted.note: Why a template can't be loaded: the worktree {folder} of the agent {agent} it would replace has work not committed.

content.templates.unreadable.note: Why a template can't be used: its file couldn't be read.
